purpose: Read-only inventory for preparing a later general entity-review training round; no training, inference, or integration performed.
label_interpretation: Weak labels only: whether the changed canonical string appears as an exact substring in the saved reference text. Reference text is not audio ground truth.

method.accepted_change_filter: production_final.entity_audio_repair.applied is true; each entry in changes with a canonical name is one change event.
method.reference_match: Exact substring check: canonical in sample.reference; no normalization or alias matching.
method.recording_key: sample.recording_id, falling back to sample id if absent.
method.grouping: Per-event counts are reported alongside unique recording counts. Entity type comes from the change record. Topic group counts use sample topics and can overlap.

canonical_absent_reference_events_for_ma.reference: 庞清和佟健仍肩负着扛起中国双人滑大旗的重任
广东惠州惊爆港商杀情妇碎尸凶案
终站是好友谢霆锋的创作
港商疑恼羞成怒将她杀害

limitations: Canonical presence or absence in a reference is only a weak text-match signal and does not establish whether the accepted audio change is right or wrong.
Name conflicts, including canonical/observed/reference disagreement, need human listening before assigning reliable labels.
Counts describe only accepted changes in these two specified saved data files; they do not measure performance on unseen data or the excluded 181-item test set.
